description: Core eval-app feature validations — real LLM + real browser, verified by an independent DOM oracle (not the agent's self-report). Self-contained: each scenario carries its own goal; run_eval resolve-or-creates the E2eTest from it (no seeder lists).

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to the tasks page, add a new task titled 'Buy groceries', and confirm that 'Buy groceries' now appears in the task list.
Log in, open the edit profile page, change the display name field to 'Casey Jordan', save the form, and confirm the change was saved.
Log in, use the search feature to search for the word 'report', and confirm that search results are shown.
